Introduces new zone flag interface for testing and setting flags:
int zone_test_and_set_flag(struct zone *zone
Instead of setting and clearing ZONE_RECLAIM_LOCKED each time shrink_zone() is
called
column2: this flag is test and set before starting zone reclaim.  Zone reclaim

column1: starts in __alloc_pages() when a zone's watermark fails and the system is in
zone_reclaim_mode.  If it's already in reclaim
column2: there's no need to start again

column1: so it is simply considered full for that allocation attempt.
There is a change of behavior with regard to concurrent zone shrinking.  It is
now possible for try_to_free_pages() or kswapd to already be shrinking a
particular zone when __alloc_pages() starts zone reclaim.  In this case
possible for two concurrent threads to invoke shrink_zone() for a single zone.
This change forbids a zone to be in zone reclaim twice
behavior
column2: but allows for concurrent try_to_free_pages() or kswapd shrinking

column1: when starting zone reclaim.
